verdict.rationale: Meltano is pip-installable and runs locally from a CLI-managed project (`meltano init`, `meltano add`, `meltano run`). Plugin configuration can be checked with `meltano config test`, and projects follow CI/CD practices, so running and testing pipelines locally is documented. The evidence never shows a lightweight local destination or a way to keep dev runs separate from production. Missing for 10: evidence of lightweight local loaders (e.g. file/DuckDB/SQLite targets), dev vs. prod environment separation, and independent hands-on corroboration of a local-test-then-promote workflow.
